text:
maya: late-night thought experiment — when you settle in for a long book, do you have a 5-song ritual to set the mood? share your sequence (no more than 5) and what book you'd pair it with. i'll start. :coffee:

sam: neat. mine: 1) Fleet Foxes - "White Winter Hymnal" 2) Nick Drake - "Northern Sky" 3) Sufjan Stevens - "Casimir Pulaski Day" 4) Laura Marling - "Sophia" 5) Olafur Arnalds - "Near Light". Pairing: anything by Kazuo Ishiguro, especially "The Remains of the Day". calm, lonely, tactile.

ben: love that. mine is more upbeat: 1) St. Vincent - "Rattlesnake" 2) TV on the Radio - "Wolf Like Me" 3) Yeah Yeah Yeahs - "Maps" 4) LCD Soundsystem - "Oh Baby" 5) Arcade Fire - "We Used to Wait". pair: big sprawling sci-fi (Leckie, Gibson) for energy between chapters. :rocket:

devon: goth corner reporting: 1) Sisters of Mercy - "Lucretia My Reflection" 2) Joy Division - "Atmosphere" 3) Dead Can Dance - "The Host of Seraphim" 4) Nick Cave - "The Ship Song" 5) Type O Negative - "Love You to Death". pair w/ dense Victorian gothic or Dostoevsky. @maya you owe me tea. :black_heart:

irene: softer rotation: 1) Joni Mitchell - "A Case of You" 2) Bill Evans - "Peace Piece" 3) Agnes Obel - "Riverside" 4) John Martyn - "Solid Air" 5) Sade - "No Ordinary Love". pairing: memoirs or travelogues, slow pacing.

alan: mine is two moods mashed: 1) Nina Simone - "I Put a Spell on You" 2) Radiohead - "Daydreaming" 3) Khruangbin - "Dern Kala" 4) Pinegrove - "Size of the Moon" 5) M83 - "Wait". pair w/ long literary novels that need emotional re-centering.

musicbot: poll: react with :one: if you prefer instrumental only, :two: for vocal-led, :three: for mixed. (auto-suggested by musicbot: try "5-song ritual" playlist template).

maya: results so far: :two: x3, :three: x2. surprising.

sam: quick tip — if you want to keep flow, make a single playlist in that exact order and don't shuffle. small mental anchor between sections of a book.

ben: question: anyone actually re-reads to songs? like same playlist every re-read?

devon: i do for crime novels. same playlist = spine memory for pacing. works weirdly well. :mag:

irene: also pro headphones with noise canceling. the room noises kill the atmosphere.

maya: thanks y'all — i'm compiling these into a 5-song-ritual playlist and will drop it in #playlists later. credit to contributors in the description. feel free to DM if you want your track removed from the public mix. :headphones:
